messages:
Maya: Morning! I made too much sourdough starter and wondered if anyone wants some? Comes in jars, labeled with feed schedule. :bread:
Jon: Oh wow yes. Ive been meaning to try baking. How much do you have?
Maya: Enough for 6 jars. Small swap setup? I can drop off Saturday afternoon.
Priya: Ill take one. Can we do an outdoor mini swap at the park so we can social-distance?
Liam: I can bring a folding cooler and some stickers for jar labels. Also gonna be out early Sunday for a sunrise paddle if anyone is into that instead of park. :sunrise:
Jon: Im in for the park swap Sat afternoon. Sunrise paddle sounds tempting but depends on sleep schedule.
Maya: Park swap proposal: Sat 3pm, Council Crest Park bench near the big oak. Bring jars and a small bag for starters. RSVP here.
Priya: RSVP yes. Also curious if anyone has tips for first feeds?
Maya: Feed with equal weight flour+water, leave at room temp 6-8 hrs, then refrigerate if not baking immediately. I'll include a note.
Liam: RSVP maybe for paddle. If we get 3+ ppl Ill bring the canoe and life jackets. Meetup at Marina ramp 6:15am Sun.
Event-bot: Event created: "Sourdough Starter Swap"  Sat 15:00 at Council Crest Park. Invited: Maya, Jon, Priya, Liam. Details: https://events.local/starter-swap
Jon: Also if anyone has rye flour to spare, Ill trade a jar for 500g of rye. :pray:
Priya: I have a little rye, can bring 300g.
Maya: Perfect. Jon, I'll mark you for a rye trade.
Liam: If paddle gets 3 people Ill text the group + bring extra thermoses of tea.
Jon: Count me as a tentative for sunrise. Depends on coffee. :coffee:
Maya: Great. See folks Sat 3pm. If anything changes Ill edit the event or ping here.
